items.headline: Berkshire Hathaway boosts Alphabet to a top three holding, ups Delta and housing bets
items.summary: Berkshire owned about 106 million shares in the parent of Google, worth $37.9 billion at the end of June, according to a regulatory filing released Friday.

items.headline: Druckenmiller loads up on Amazon and AMD while dumping some chipmakers, 13F shows
Stocks See Support from Favorable PPI Report
U.S. to use economic tactics on Iran 'that have never been seen'; Navy works to relieve troubled carrier USS Abraham Lincoln
items.summary: The Trump administration is ratcheting up rhetorical pressure on Iran as the military conflict in Iran appears mired in a strategic stalemate.

items.headline: OpenAI talent exodus raises 'huge red flag' ahead of IPO
items.summary: OpenAI's C-suite turnover gives investors another reason for concern as the company pushes toward a mammoth IPO.

items.headline: Regulators and banks step up scrutiny of prediction markets
items.summary: The CFTC is reviewing prediction betting platforms' so-called mention markets, people familiar with the matter confirmed to CNBC.

items.headline: Goldman Sachs Expands Bitcoin Push With $2.25B Asset Manager Deal
Berkshire buys more Alphabet, which becomes its third-largest stock investment
Trump family-backed crypto firm World Liberty gets conditional bank charter approval
items.summary: The OCC conditionally approved World Liberty Trust Company’s national trust bank charter. That would allow the Trump family-backed firm to issue stablecoins.

items.headline: US stock: S&P 500 ends lower as investors weigh data, Middle East tensions
items.summary: The S&P 500's streak came to an end, falling from its peak as weaker retail sales suggested caution among consumers. Despite a strong outlook, Applied Materials saw its shares slump, dragging down AI-related stocks. In contrast, rising oil prices helped lift the energy index. Reddit experienced a surge following news of its index inclusion.

items.headline: Goldman’s latest cash cow is all about funding the AI infrastructure boom
items.summary: Nvidia and Intel recently tapped the bank to help them meeting soaring demand for compute.

items.headline: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty in federal case related to UnitedHealthcare CEO killing
items.summary: Mangione's lawyers argue his federal plea bars his prosecution for murder in state court for Brian Thompson's slaying due to New York's double jeopardy law

items.headline: Trump asks Supreme Court to let White House ballroom construction continue
items.summary: President Donald Trump tore down the White House East Wing to make way for the ballroom project.

items.headline: Meta Says It’s Shut Down 750,000 Youth Accounts in Australia
items.summary: Meta Platforms Inc. says it has removed access to more than 750,000 Instagram and Facebook accounts in Australia believed to belong to people under 16 since it began complying with the country’s landmark youth social media ban last year.

items.headline: 10-year Treasury yield inches higher as traders digest soft retail sales, monitor the Middle East
items.summary: The moves come after the latest retail sales figures missed expectations and the U.S. said its naval blockade of Iranian ports could continue "indefinitely."

items.headline: Lamborghini unveils Revuelto SV, its most powerful production car ever
items.summary: Lamborghini's Revuelto SV is a limited-edition V12 hybrid with over 1,050 horsepower, a 2.4-second 0-to-100 kph time and a $741,172 starting price.

items.headline: Group including Jeff Bezos buys minority stake in Liverpool FC, with option to become controlling owner
items.summary: The group that includes Jeff Bezos has an option to become the majority shareholder within the next year.

items.headline: Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro tells CNBC parks were 'big surprise' in last quarter, company has 'clarity' and 'stability'
items.summary: New CEO Josh D'Amaro has said his strategy for continued growth at Disney is centered around storytelling, intellectual property and technology.

items.headline: Court rules companies can't import Gilead medications from overseas in blow to AFP health programs
items.summary: A U.S. appeals court has ruled in favor of Gilead Sciences against companies known as alternative funding programs that import medicines from overseas.

items.headline: New CNBC Generation Lab poll shows almost half of 18- to 34-year-olds see democratic socialism positively
items.summary: New CNBC Generation Lab poll shows almost half of 18- to 34-year-olds see democratic socialism positively and nearly 80% see the U.S. economy negatively.
